en.title: GTA 6 Shatters Records: Biggest Entertainment Launch in History
en.summary: Rockstar's highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI has officially become the biggest entertainment launch of all time, raking in billions on its first day. The game has also set new benchmarks for player engagement on PlayStation.
en.body:
The dust has barely settled, but **Grand Theft Auto VI** has already cemented its place in history, officially becoming the biggest entertainment launch of all time. Rockstar Games has delivered a phenomenon, with initial reports indicating a staggering **$3.79 billion** earned in its first 24 hours alone. This colossal figure eclipses all previous entertainment releases, from blockbuster films to chart-topping music albums.

PlayStation has confirmed that **GTA 6** is not just a commercial juggernaut but also a player engagement powerhouse on its platform. The game has achieved the single largest game release in PlayStation history, with over 39 million unique players diving into the vibrant world of Leonida on PlayStation 5. This monumental figure includes setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game, outshining even massively popular multiplayer and free-to-play titles. Players have collectively logged an astonishing 683 million hours, with the average player dedicating approximately 17.4 hours to virtual heists and exploration in the game's initial days. Furthermore, **GTA 6**'s launch prompted a significant surge in PS5 console sales, marking the largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console's 2020 debut, excluding holiday periods. A remarkable 70% of these new consoles had **GTA 6** as their first played game.

## A New Benchmark for Success

Beyond the console-specific triumphs, **GTA 6**'s impact reverberates across the entire entertainment landscape. The game's pre-release sales alone were extraordinary, with 32.5 million units sold before its official November 19 launch, setting a new pre-release record across all platforms. Internet providers have also reported unprecedented traffic spikes directly attributed to the game's launch day. Comcast, for instance, noted its highest-traffic day ever, with **GTA 6** accounting for 24% of peak internet traffic as players downloaded and immersed themselves in the game. Xbox consoles also saw a massive fourfold increase in internet traffic related to **GTA 6**.

## Community Reactions and the Road Ahead

Despite the overwhelming commercial success, the gaming community has seen a mixed reaction in terms of player reviews, with some outlets reporting a significant review bombing campaign that has impacted aggregate scores on platforms like Metacritic. This phenomenon, unfortunately, has become a recurring issue in the industry, sometimes overshadowing the immense achievements of developers. However, for the millions of players experiencing **GTA 6**, the sheer scale and ambition of Rockstar's latest creation are undeniable. The game's detailed open world, featuring protagonists Lucia and Jason navigating the colorful streets of Vice City and the expansive state of Leonida, has captivated a global audience.

## What's Next

While **GTA 6** is currently available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, details regarding a potential PC release or future content updates have not yet been officially announced by Rockstar Games. Fans eagerly await further information on what's next for this record-breaking title.

content_raw: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history. PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles. On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days. What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles. GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours. On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever , with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November. People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.” It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. Rockstar certainly set a new standard for the industry with this one, to the point where many users aren’t sure if a photo they see online is from the real world or from the game .
